codeTrouble.title: Code Trouble
codeTrouble.description: Collaborative platform inspired by Q&A forums and technical articles. The project involved responsive design using the 'Atomic Design' methodology, a unique visual identity, and a focus on user experience, integrations, and usability testing.

crjSolucoes.title: CRJ Solutions
crjSolucoes.description: Institutional multipage website project for a building maintenance company. It involved sitemap structuring, content hierarchy definition, responsive layout creation (desktop and mobile), service organization focused on condominiums and companies, and visual standardization to reinforce credibility, clarity, and conversion via WhatsApp.

elevare.title: Elevare

joysGourmet.title: Joys Gourmet
joysGourmet.description: Visual identity project for Joy’s Gourmet, specialized in catering for corporate events. The work focused on sophistication, elegance, and credibility, with brand application in physical materials, uniforms, menus, and a visual base for future expansions such as websites and physical products.

profCorrea.title: Prof Correa

sante.title: Santé

teacherMarceli.title: Teacher Marceli
teacherMarceli.description: Project focused on the visual and strategic structuring of the English teacher. Development of visual identity, content hierarchy definition, offer organization, and creation of a landing page focused on clarity, warmth, and conversion.
